name: COMMAND MADNESS [THE BANANA UPDATE]
desc:
•Become an Admin and hunt down the Survivors to get Abuse Points. Use your Abuse Points to unlock stronger and more fun Admin Commands!

•Become a Survivor and avoid the Admin to get Survivor Points. Use your Survivor Points to unlock tools which help you survive easier!

(You can't earn Points or Wins in VIP Servers but +800 Abuse Points and +400 Survivor Points are given to everyone every 8 minutes.)
